description: Checks an x402 (HTTP 402 payment) endpoint before you pay: one unpaid GET, then the HTTP status, whether a 402 challenge with an accepts list is present, the payment networks, asset, price and pay-to address format, CORS header and response time. Does not pay, does not verify the seller's identity or reputation, and gives one sample, not uptime. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_x402_endpoint_health_vetting
title: Agent Intel X402 Endpoint Health Vetting
